subtitle.ja: 3Dモデリング・スカルプト・ノード (sonerx7)

description.en:
Blender-NX brings the Blender 4.2 LTS creation suite natively to Nexvyn OS on Nintendo Switch (N3-N4 256MB profile). Orbit, sculpt, unwrap UVs, inspect Principled BSDF v2 materials, build Geometry Nodes graphs and play keyframe animations at 60 FPS with full Joy-Con, Pro Controller, touch and mouse support. Port by sonerx7.

• 7 dedicated workspaces: Layout, Modeling, Sculpting, UV Edit, Shading, Animation and GeoNodes
• OpenGL 4.3 EEVEE Next viewport with Studio, Red Wax MatCap, Wireframe and Material Preview
• Interactive 3D Sculpting brushes (Draw, Clay, Smooth, Flatten, Inflate, Grab) with X-Symmetry
• Modifier stack (Subdivision Surface, Mirror, Solidify) and Principled BSDF v2 shader inspector
• Export scenes directly to .blend, .obj, .gltf and .stl formats
• Full controller mapping: L-Stick orbit, R-Stick pan, ZL/ZR zoom, L/R switch workspaces
description.tr:
Blender-NX, Blender 4.2 LTS 3D tasarım paketini Nexvyn OS N3-N4 (256MB) altyapısıyla Nintendo Switch'e yerel olarak getirir. Tam Joy-Con, Pro Controller, dokunmatik ve fare desteğiyle 60 FPS'de 3D modelleme, Red Wax heykel tıraşlık, UV düzenleme, Principled BSDF v2 materyaller, Geometry Nodes ve Dope Sheet animasyonları oluşturun. Port by sonerx7.

• 7 çalışma alanı: Layout, Modeling, Sculpting, UV Edit, Shading, Animasyon ve GeoNodes
• Studio, Red Wax MatCap, Wireframe ve Material Preview modlu OpenGL 4.3 EEVEE Next görünümü
• X-Simetrisi destekli interaktif 3D Heykel fırçaları (Draw, Clay, Smooth, Flatten, Inflate, Grab)
• Modifikatör yığını (Subdivision Surface, Mirror, Solidify) ve Principled BSDF v2 denetleyicisi
• Sahneleri .blend, .obj, .gltf ve .stl formatlarında dışa aktarma
• Tam kumanda uyumu: L-Stick Orbit, R-Stick Pan, ZL/ZR Zoom, L/R sekme geçişi

changelog.en: v4.2.0: Full Blender 4.2 LTS UI redesign with vector icons, dynamic 3D navigation gizmo, vertical Properties icon rail, UV Editor, Dope Sheet, Geometry Nodes and native N3-N4 fullscreen support. Port by sonerx7.
changelog.tr: v4.2.0: Vektörel ikonlar, dinamik 3D navigation gizmo, dikey Properties ikon şeridi, UV Editörü, Dope Sheet, Geometry Nodes ve yerel N3-N4 tam ekran desteğiyle tam Blender 4.2 LTS arayüzü. Port by sonerx7.
